definitions.explanation: A polite way of addressing or referring to a group of people. More formal than みなさん, commonly used in announcements, speeches, and formal writing.

examples.japanese: {皆様|みなさま}、おはようございます。
{皆様|みなさま}のご{協力|きょうりょく}に{感謝|かんしゃ}いたします。
examples.english: I am grateful for everyone's cooperation.

examples.japanese: {皆様|みなさま}のご{健康|けんこう}とご{多幸|たこう}をお{祈|いの}りいたします。
examples.english: I wish everyone good health and happiness.

notes:
FORMALITY:
{皆様|みなさま} is the polite/formal form of みなさん. It is standard in business correspondence, public announcements, and formal speeches. みなさん is appropriate for everyday polite conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皆様|みなさま}へ (to everyone — used in letter/email openings)
- {皆様|みなさま}のおかげで (thanks to everyone)
- お{客様|きゃくさま}{皆様|みなさま} (all of our customers)
